set.pl: Horrigan land across the north tier of sec. 2 T10N R3W, Town of Scott, Crawford County, between Mt. Zion and Soldiers Grove (16.7 mi due north of Boscobel)
pinev: c.1915 Hixson plat of Crawford County shows Horrigan land (about 168 acres) across the north tier of sec. 2 T10N R3W, 16.7 mi due north of Boscobel, matching '17 miles from Boscobel'; placed in that tier from BLM PLSS (about 450 m).

tw-horrigan-boscobel-1930.st: Placed: the c.1915 county plat shows Horrigan land across the north tier of sec. 2, Town of Scott, Crawford County, 16.7 miles due north of Boscobel, which fits '17 miles from Boscobel'. Private farm: ask permission.
src: Hixson, Plat Book of Crawford County, Wisconsin (c.1915), Town of Scott

set.pl: SW¼ NE¼ sec. 10 T23N R6E, about 1.1 mi east of the old Rudolph post office

au-wi-rudolph-1894.st: Placed: the c.1915 Wood County plat shows a forty in SW¼ NE¼ sec. 10 T23N R6E about 1.1 miles east of the Rudolph post office, matching 'a mile east'; the pin is at the centre of that forty.
src: Hixson, Plat Book of Wood County, Wisconsin (c.1915), Town of Rudolph
